title: How to Merge and Split PDFs with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Merge, split, and process PDF files without building a custom integration. Describe the task in Claude, let Medux handle the document operation, and save the finished file back to your workspace.
operation: Merge, split, and process PDF files without building a custom integration. Describe the task in Claude, let Medux handle the document operation, and save the finished file back to your workspace.
prompt: Use Medux to merge a.pdf and b.pdf into one PDF. Upload the files with curl, run the merge task, and save the final result in the current project folder.
